items.title: Christian Gonzalez: Gets massive extension from New England
items.body_text: Gonzalez signed a four-year, $135 million extension, with $102 million guaranteed, with the Patriots on Monday, NFL reporter Jordan Schultz reports. Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: George Kittle: Looking increasingly likely to play vs. Rams
items.body_text: Kittle (Achilles) is in full uniform for the 49ers' practice session in Melbourne, Australia on Tuesday (local time), Nick Wagoner of ESPN.com reports. Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Christian McCaffrey: Fully dressed for second practice of week
items.body_text: McCaffrey (undisclosed) is in full uniform for the 49ers' practice session taking place Tuesday afternoon local time in Melbourne, Australia, Nick Wagoner of ESPN.com reports. Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: De'Zhaun Stribling: Suited up for practice Monday
items.body_text: Stribling (shoulder) is in full uniform for Monday's practice in Melbourne, Australia, Nick Wagoner of ESPN.com reports. Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Darius Slayton: Cut loose by Giants
items.body_text: The Giants released Slayton on Monday, Matt Zenitz of CBS Sports reports. Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.
